add_player.title: Add a player
add_player.description: Name the player. Next you choose how to find their Epic account: signing in fills in the Epic Games Account ID for you.

data_description.player_id: Becomes part of entity IDs: lowercase letters, numbers, underscores. Left empty, it is made from the name.

add_player_method.title: Find the Epic account
add_player_method.description: Signing in is the easy way: the Epic Games Account ID is read from the sign-in, and Sprites, level and Power Ranking are linked at the same time.

menu_options.add_player_epic: Sign in with Epic (finds the account ID automatically)
menu_options.add_player_manual: Enter the Epic Games Account ID myself

add_player_epic.title: Sign in to Epic Games
add_player_epic.description:
1. Make sure the browser is **not signed in to a different Epic account**: open the link in a private/incognito window, or sign out of epicgames.com first.
2. Open [Epic Games sign-in]({url}), sign in as **{player}** and approve access. Console players sign in with the PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo button.
3. Come back here and press **Submit**.

The account ID is taken from this sign-in. Only a device credential is stored in Home Assistant; the password never is. The link expires after about 10 minutes.

add_player_confirm.title: Confirm the Epic account
add_player_confirm.description:
Epic signed in as **{epic_name}** (account ID ending in {account_tail}).

Press **Submit** to track this account as **{player}**. If this is the wrong account, close this dialog: nothing is saved, and the unused sign-in can be removed from that Epic account's settings.

add_player_manual.title: Enter the Epic account ID
add_player_manual.description: Epic Games Account ID for **{player}** (32 letters and digits, shown on epicgames.com under Account). Epic can be linked later from Configure.

remove_player.title: Remove a player
remove_player.description: Stops tracking the player. Their entities can then be deleted from the entity list.

link_epic.title: Link Epic account
link_epic.description: Choose which tracked player is signing in.

link_epic_signin.title: Sign in to Epic Games
link_epic_signin.description:
1. Open [Epic Games sign-in]({url}) and sign in as **{player}**, then approve access.
2. Come back here and press **Submit**.

Only a device credential is stored in Home Assistant; the password never is. The link expires after about 10 minutes.

unlink_epic.title: Unlink Epic account
unlink_epic.description: Removes the stored device credential from Home Assistant. To revoke it at Epic too, remove the device from your Epic account settings.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to api-fortnite.com. Check network and API status.
error.invalid_auth: The configured API key was rejected.
error.player_not_found: No stats found for this Epic Games Account ID.
error.invalid_player_id: Use 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
error.link_pending: Epic has not confirmed the sign-in yet. Finish signing in, then press Submit again.
error.link_expired: The sign-in link expired; a new one is shown below.
error.link_failed: Epic sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

abort.last_player: At least one player must remain tracked.
abort.identity_mismatch: That Epic account does not match this player's configured account ID, so nothing was saved.
abort.link_unavailable: Could not start Epic sign-in (api-fortnite.com did not return a sign-in link).
abort.account_already_tracked: That sign-in was for an Epic account that is already tracked, so nothing was saved. The browser was probably still signed in as another player: use a private window and try again.
abort.link_no_account: Epic sign-in finished but did not return a single account ID and device credential, so nothing was saved.

epic_relink.title: Link {player}'s Epic account again
epic_relink.description: Epic rejected the stored sign-in for {player}, so Sprites, level and Power Ranking are paused. Go to Settings > Devices & services > Fortnite Activity Tracker > Configure > Link Epic account.

stats_private.title: {player}'s Fortnite stats are private
stats_private.description: Epic refused to share {player}'s match stats because **Public Game Stats** is switched off on that Epic account, so lifetime, season, today and weekly stats and sessions cannot be shown. In Fortnite open Settings > Account and Privacy > Gameplay Privacy and turn **Public Game Stats** on (a child's account may need a parent to allow it). The stats appear at the next refresh and this notice clears itself.
